reason: I run three AI agents a day and lose context every time I switch; a shared layer that keeps skills, sessions, and credentials across Claude Code, Cursor, and whatever else my team uses is exactly my problem. First five humans free means I can try it before paying anything.
objection: I can't force my team onto one agent, and I don't trust one local daemon with all our credentials until I see it actually hand off context between two different agents without breaking.
would_change_my_mind: A live demo where a task started in Claude Code continues in Cursor with full context, using our real MCP servers.
